honesty: TTL is the failover floor: resume p50 ≈ TTL + detection when ownership wait is included. Raising TTL alone cuts false fences but slows every crash recovery. Preferred production levers (renew every ⅕ TTL + regional lease store) are not knobs in celld 0.4.0 — only CELLD_TTL_MS is exposed. ttl_only_30s is a tradeoff demo, not the preferred sole tune. Not durable execution / exactly-once.
